learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic knowledge about number theory and apply basic operations in number theory.
Know the classical cipher systems shift cipher, substitution cipher, affine cipher, Vigenere cipher, Hill cipher, permutation cipher, and encrypt and decrpyt by using these methods.
Know the modern cipher systems RSA and ElGamal cipher, and encrypt and decrpyt by using these methods.

syllabus_topics: Shift cipher Substitution cipher Affine cipher
Vigenere cipher Hill cipher Permutation cipher
Primality test and prime number generation
bibliography: B. Schneier, Applied Cryptography: Protocols, algorithms and source code in C, Wiley, 1996. D. R. Stinson, Cryptography: Theory and Practice, CRC, 1995.
1) E. Afacan, Kriptografiye Giriş, Epos Yayınları, 2016.
